title: Crystal Anvil
text: Assemble an anvil with six crystal casings. Keeps vanilla repair, enchantment combining and renaming. Each operation uses one of its 16 durability points. At zero it pauses instead of breaking.
Draws up to 10 mana per second in total from players within five blocks. Every 200 mana restores one durability. Breaking and replacing it does not reset durability.
